title: Restaurant service robot
summary: A JetBot that seated guests and delivered food to the right table using QR codes.
description:
For an Embedded Visual Control course project, our team built a restaurant service robot for a model restaurant with four tables and a kitchen. It detected arriving guests, counted the group, selected a suitable table, and later collected food from the kitchen for delivery.

My assigned part was the QR-code-based food delivery: reading the code at the kitchen and directing the robot to the correct table. We integrated the camera, movement and decision-making components and tested the system on the physical JetBot. In the final evaluation, it typically reached destinations in around 10 seconds, with positioning accuracy of about 5 cm. Obstacle detection and avoidance were part of the original plan but were not implemented.
